title: Verify Parts Manager can see all pricing and financial data on work orders and parts
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Parts Manager role. (this role has See Financial Data ON).
At least one work order exists that contains labor and part lines with prices entered.
Parts with prices exist in the catalog.
steps:
1. Click Work Orders, open a work order, and check line prices and totals.
  2. Click Parts, open the Catalog, and check part prices.
expected: All prices are visible with actual amounts on both work orders and parts.
